Subject: Stakeholder map & MAP creation — next steps

Thanks for the time today, Daniel — appreciate the candid overview of FinPay's goals and timeline. Quick recap and proposed next steps from my side: 

- Economic buyer: you mentioned CFO Rebecca Torres (confirmed). We'll need a short ROI slide for her.
- Decision criteria: latency (p99), cost per 1M tokens, data residency, and SOC 2 evidence.
- Security/legal/procurement: you flagged a standard procurement timeline (~4–6 weeks) and a security questionnaire for our SOC 2 controls.

Proposed next steps: 
1) Share a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with milestones and owners (attached).
2) Intro to procurement and legal so we can line up the questionnaire and contract timeline.
3) Schedule a 30-min follow-up to walk the MAP and confirm milestone dates — I'm available Tue/Thu next week.

Attached: FinPay-MAP-v1.docx (draft MAP, milestone owners) and SOC2-summary.pdf (one-page control map).

If that aligns, I'll wait for the procurement/legal contacts or feel free to loop them in.

Best,
Marissa

Subject: Re: Stakeholder map & MAP creation — next steps

Appreciate the fast response, Daniel. Answering your questions and attaching an updated MAP with cost ranges and milestones: 

- Pilot timeline: 4–6 weeks to demo-ready pilot (integration, test prompts, basic evals).
- Production (small scale): additional 4–8 weeks depending on procurement and security review.
- Costs: included in the MAP are two scenarios: Hosted (fastest on/off ramp, lower upfront) and Dedicated (lower per-token cost at scale; requires procurement lead time).

Draft MAP highlights (attached FinPay-MAP-v1.docx):
1) Week 0–1: Kickoff + stakeholder alignment (owner: Marissa)
2) Week 1–3: Technical onboarding + test prompts (owner: Mateo)
3) Week 3–5: Pilot evaluation & ROI check-in (owner: Daniel)
4) Week 5–8: Security/legal review + contract negotiation (owner: Procurement)
5) Week 8+: CanOpen — production cutover planning (owner: Customer Eng)

Decision criteria to call out in the MAP: latency (p95/p99), inference cost per 1M tokens, data residency, SOC2 attestation, and SLA.

Attachments: FinPay-MAP-v1.docx (updated with cost ranges) and SOC2-summary.pdf.

Can Camila confirm the milestone owners on our side and whether we should add an explicit contingency for procurement delay?

Best,
Marissa
